description: This Java source file defines the class OpenVmTraceHandler, which implements ClientData.IMethodProfilingHandler to handle VM trace data, save it to a temporary file, and open it in an editor within an Android development environment.

classes.name: OpenVmTraceHandler
classes.description: Handles VM trace data from Android devices, saves it to a temporary file, and opens it in the IDE.

methods.name: OpenVmTraceHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a project context.

methods.name: onSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful retrieval of trace data as a byte array, saves it to a temp file, and opens it in the editor.

methods.name: onStartFailure
methods.description: Handles failure to start profiling, shows an error message.

methods.name: onEndFailure
methods.description: Handles failure to end profiling, shows an error message.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in a dialog.
